competitors.name: Again Faster
competitors.observation: Maintenance framing reviewed; it does not own a receiving evidence model, defect taxonomy or lot decision workflow.

competitors.name: Iron Company
competitors.observation: Buyer-guide positioning reviewed. Numerical marketing claims were not reused; the new guide focuses on reproducible defect records.

competitors.name: Escape Fitness
competitors.observation: Product-specific handling language confirms why one model's warning cannot become a universal acceptance or service-life claim.

rejectedTopics: Crumb versus virgin rubber — the existing manufacturing guide already owns construction and material comparison.
Loose hub or insert — a dedicated multilingual retention guide owns that interface.
Bounce and Shore hardness — a dedicated guide owns rebound and hardness evidence.
Rubber coating peeling — the existing adhesion guide owns coated iron products rather than bumper-plate body splits.
siteGaps: No page separated closed mould seams, gouges, open body cracks, edge splits, missing material, shedding and hub-boundary tearing while connecting each observation to receiving evidence and lot containment.
